facing.Text: What do you know of what we're facing?

hello.Text: Facing fierce resistance from the alien scum, are we? A good thing we have more Unicorns in the area to assist you.

help.Text: Thought as much. Just a second and I'll get hold of the cavalry. The Unicorn Recon Agent activates a homing beacon. Shouldn't be long now. Good luck!

facing.Text: The aliens have dug in throughout this sector. Their genesplicer is the one running the operation — take him down and the rest should break.
